page.content:
2014 film in which Emmet, Wyldstyle, and Vitruvius treat the brick world as a story.

How The LEGO Movie connects

  • Character: Emmet Brickowski — Emmet Brickowski is the construction-worker hero of The LEGO Movie.
  • Topic: LEGO — The LEGO Movie is the feature that put the brick world on screen.
  • Character: Wyldstyle — Wyldstyle is the Master Builder who pulls Emmet into The LEGO Movie.
  • Character: Lord Business — Lord Business is the suited antagonist of The LEGO Movie.
  • Faction: The LEGO Group — The LEGO Group backed The LEGO Movie as a brick-world feature.
  • Concept: Brickfilm — Brickfilm grammar shaped how The LEGO Movie moves minifigures.

What is The LEGO Movie?

The LEGO Movie follows Emmet Brickowski through a Master Builder adventure opposite Lord Business, turning the System of Play, minifigures, and fan brickfilms into a feature that sent adults back to the brick.

Key threads lead to Emmet Brickowski, LEGO, Wyldstyle, Lord Business, The LEGO Group and Brickfilm.
